intent: One toast that follows one async job. It opens on loading with a hairline sweeping its lower edge, morphs in place to success or error, and on success offers Undo whose countdown is a ring around the button. Hover or focus pauses the ring, a swipe or Esc dismisses it, and the copy is announced politely.

stack.animation: motion/react (useMotionValue and useTransform for the countdown ring and swipe offset, animate for the countdown and spring back, AnimatePresence with mode wait for status copy and glyph, a variant set with custom direction for the exit, useInView for the demo entrance)

layout.card: 392px wide (full width under 640px), radius 14px, padding 14px 16px 16px; one row: 18px status glyph, text column (flex-1), then Undo (76 x 32px pill) and a 28px dismiss button with 4px gap
layout.placement: absolute inside the nearest relative parent by default, or fixed to the viewport; bottom-right, bottom-center or top-right at 24px from the edges; under 640px it spans the full width with 16px gutters on the bottom or top edge
layout.ring: rounded rect 84.5 x 40.5 radius 20.25 drawn 5px outside the Undo button in an 86 x 42 svg; dash length equals the perimeter (2*pi*20.25 + 2*(84.5 - 40.5) = 215.2) and the dash offset is (1 - remaining) * length
layout.hairline: 2px tall along the card's lower edge, clipped by the card's radius; loading sweep 40% wide, success and error bars scale from the left edge
layout.demo: 560px column: a card 440px tall with a bottom padding of 128px reserved for the toast, header with 'Inbox' and a mono count, a toolbar row with the Archive 12 threads pill and five thread rows with 32px monograms, footer hint in mono

typography.title: Geist (font-sans) 500, 14px / 20px, tracking -0.01em
typography.labels: 13px 500 for Undo and the demo's pill button
typography.demoMeta: mono 11px tabular-nums for counts and times

color.approach: monochrome first: ink and muted greys carry all the copy and controls; success (#6fd08c dark, #3f8a50 light) and error (#ff7a6b dark, #c9553d light) are the only hues and appear only on the glyph and the settled hairline
color.dark: card #17171a; hairline rgba(255,255,255,0.09); ink #f4f4f5; muted #a1a1aa; undo fill rgba(255,255,255,0.06) with hover 0.12; shadow 0 28px 56px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.85) plus 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)
color.light: card #ffffff; hairline rgba(24,24,27,0.09); ink #18181b; muted #52525b; undo fill rgba(24,24,27,0.05) with hover 0.09
color.demo: dark stage #000 with a #0b0b0c card; light stage #f4f4f5 with a white card; the stage follows the theme control

motion.entrance: card rises 14px from opacity 0 with a 6px blur that clears over 420ms on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
motion.statusSwap: copy and glyph cross-fade with a 6px rise, 3px blur, 260ms; outgoing copy 160ms ease-in; no hard cut
motion.glyphs: spinner: 18px ring with a 90-degree arc, one turn per 1.2s; success check draws its stroke over 340ms after an 80ms delay; error is a circle with a cross
motion.sweep: loading hairline sweep: 40% wide soft gradient moving left to right every 1.3s, linear, repeating
motion.resolve: success or error hairline scales from its left edge over 500ms; the success bar fades 1.1s later
motion.countdown: ring drains linearly over the undo window from a motion value (1 to 0); hover, focus or a hidden tab pauses it in place and resume continues from the same point; empty means the toast leaves
motion.undo: Undo appears with a 220ms scale from 0.92 and opacity; pressing it swaps the glyph to a return arrow, restores the copy and leaves after 1.6s
motion.swipe: horizontal drag with 0.35 rubber band; past 90px or faster than 500px/s it dismisses in the drag direction (420px fly and fade); otherwise a spring back (stiffness 420, damping 36); touch-action pan-y
motion.exit: dismiss drops 8px and fades over 220ms on cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)
motion.reducedMotion: no rise, blur, fly, spin or sweep; opacity changes over 150ms; the countdown still drains because it reports time

responsive.widths: designed at 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920px: the toast is full width with gutters below 640px and 392px from the chosen corner above it
responsive.overflow: no horizontal scroll at any width; the text column truncates nothing because the description wraps to two lines at most
responsive.touch: dismiss 28px and Undo 32px tall; the card is the swipe surface; no hover-only controls

accessibility: role=status with aria-live=polite carries 'title. description' once per status change; the countdown never announces
the card has aria-labelledby pointing at its title
Undo and dismiss are real buttons; dismiss has aria-label=Dismiss; focus rings are 2px with a 2px offset in the current colour and show for keyboard focus only
Escape inside the toast dismisses it
hover pauses the ring and focus within pauses it too, so a keyboard user can read the copy and reach Undo before it leaves
reduced motion keeps opacity changes and the countdown; spinner and sweep are static
errors do not expire on a timer: they stay until dismissed
contrast: ink on the card and muted copy meet WCAG AA; success and error are used on glyphs and hairlines only, never as text

content.loading: Archiving 12 threads… / Moving them out of your inbox
content.success: Archived 12 threads / Moved to Archive · 5 s to undo
content.error: Couldn’t archive 12 threads / Nothing was archived. Your inbox is unchanged.
content.undone: Restored 12 threads / Put back where it was
content.bin: Moving 3 drafts to bin… / The bin keeps them for 30 days; Moved 3 drafts to bin / Kept for 30 days

avoid: stacking or fanning several toasts (that is toast-stack)
a spinner that never resolves or a progress bar with an invented percentage
confetti, sparkles, emoji, a tick in a rounded square, or a coloured card per state
a ticking number as the countdown: the ring is the countdown and the description states the window once
restarting the countdown on hover, or leaving it running while the pointer is on the toast
glassmorphism, glow, gradient text, bouncing entrances, or infinite pulses on content
hard cuts between states; every change is a cross-fade or a morph
